invite.title: Parent invite code
invite.hint: Create an invite code and give it to your parent so they can follow your progress. The code is valid for 48 hours and can be used only once. After your parent enters it, you need to approve the request here.
invite.shownOnce: This code is shown only now. Share it with your parent; you won't be able to see it again after leaving the page.
invite.activeCode: You have a valid invite code (until {{date}}). If you lost it, create a new one — the old code will stop working.
invite.limitReached: You can link at most {{max}} parents (pending requests included). Remove one to add a new parent.

revokeConfirm.title: Remove parent link
revokeConfirm.message: {{name}} will no longer see your information. Continue?

invite.loadError: Linked parents could not be loaded.
invite.generateError: The invite code could not be created.
invite.copyError: The code could not be copied; select and copy it manually.
invite.revokeError: The link could not be removed.
invite.pendingHint: Approve only if you know this person; otherwise reject. They cannot see your information unless you approve.
invite.approveError: The request could not be approved.
invite.rejectError: The request could not be rejected.
invite.pendingWarning: Reject this request if you don't recognise it or if your parent says the code didn't work.

children.title: My children
children.subtitle: Children linked to your account.
children.addHint: Enter the 12-character invite code your child created on their Settings page. The link becomes active once your child approves the request.
children.redeemError: The code is invalid or has expired.
children.empty: No children linked yet. Ask your child for an invite code.

revokeConfirm.title: Remove child link
revokeConfirm.message: You will no longer have access to {{name}}'s information. A new invite code is needed to link again. Continue?

children.loadError: Your children could not be loaded.
children.revokeError: The link could not be removed.
children.requested: Request sent. The link becomes active once your child approves it.
children.pendingHint: Your child's details will appear here once they approve the request. Approval deadline: {{date}}

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel link request
cancelConfirm.message: The pending link request will be cancelled. A new invite code is needed to request again. Continue?
